summary: Search code with automatic current-source verification.

help:
Usage: st search [OPTIONS] [QUERY]...

  Search code with automatic current-source verification.

  ST is optional precision navigation for ranked discovery and current
  definitions. Use rg/rg --files for exact literals, regex, multiple needles,
  file enumeration and exhaustive references. Search before adding code and
  reuse a close match.

  --text joins arguments into one case-insensitive literal phrase. --file
  lists that file's symbols independently of the query. --budget applies only
  to precision context. Whole-file reduction estimates are hypothetical whole-
  file baselines, not savings against a native search/read workflow.

  The default auto scope validates indexed candidates against current source
  and recovers stale or missing definitions. Use --scope checkout for an
  alternate or offline checkout. Follow verification warnings and narrow
  truncated results for more source.

Arguments:
  [QUERY]...  Search query (symbol name, function, class, endpoint)

Options:
  -P, --project TEXT              Project ID (overrides auto-detection for
                                  this search)
  -b, --budget INTEGER            Token budget for precision prompt context
                                  only (not primitives)  [default: 1200]
  -l, --limit INTEGER             Maximum primitive results  [default: 20]
  --offset INTEGER                Primitive result offset for text, symbols,
                                  or file listings  [default: 0]
  --text                          Join query arguments into one case-
                                  insensitive literal phrase
  --symbols                       Use the symbol search primitive
  -j, --json                      Emit full JSON payload
  -f, --file TEXT                 List symbols in a file independently of the
                                  query
  --path TEXT                     Restrict to an existing in-root file/subtree
                                  (relative or absolute)
  --hint / --no-hint              Show refinement hints when results are poor
                                  [default: hint]
  --scope [auto|project|checkout]
                                  auto: verify current source and recover
                                  definitions; project: hosted project source;
                                  checkout: local search for alternate or
                                  offline checkouts  [default: auto]
  --install-completion            Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion               Show completion for the current shell, to
                                  copy it or customize the installation.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.

usage.when: optional precision navigation for ranked discovery and current definitions; search before adding duplicate code and extend a close match
precautions: prefer ST when ranked discovery or current source excerpts help; use rg/rg --files for exact literals, regex, multiple needles, file enumeration and exhaustive references
